node.statement: Define e_2 := (1/2) min{1, e_s2^0, e_ext/C_s2^0, e_iso_unit/[C_s2^0(|C_ext+1|+1)]} and D_2 := 1 + C_s2^0(|C_ext| + |C_iso_unit|(|C_ext|+1)). These are positive/finite universal constants (in particular D_2<infinity and e_2>0), and elementary real arithmetic gives e_2<=e_s2^0, C_s2^0 e_2<=e_ext, and (C_ext+1)C_s2^0 e_2<=e_iso_unit. Moreover D_2>=C_ext C_s2^0 and D_2>=C_iso_unit(C_ext+1)C_s2^0.
